svg.text: Remote workers get a real shell. Every invocation inside the same rails.

g.text: curl, wget, nc, socat, ssh, nmap, nuclei and friends are refused outright.
openssl x509 reads a certificate; openssl s_client is refused. The tool knows
the difference: "command 's_client' is not allowed in this scan mode."
Wall clock, memory, CPU time, and process count are capped by the harness.
A runaway command is killed and comes back as a clean tool error with the
budget noted in it, so the scan continues instead of dying.
There is no network tool at all: the tool is absent, the prompt filters network
tools, the shell refuses network binaries, and the container has no egress.
